<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OEE"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/oee">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MachineData" name="Machine data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_StopCommand" name="Stop machine command"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_EngineerEmail" name="Email to engineer"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OEE">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OEE" name="OEE Process" processRef="Process_OEE"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Machine" name="Machine"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Engineer" name="Engineer"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_MachineData" name="Machine data" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="Evt_DataReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Disconnected_Idle" name="Machine disconnected" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="Evt_Disconnected_Idle"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Disconnected_Stop" name="Machine disconnected" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="Evt_Disconnected_Stop"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Restarted" name="Machine restarted" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="Evt_Restarted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_StopCommand" name="Stop command" sourceRef="Task_StopMachine" targetRef="Participant_Machine"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_EngineerEmail" name="Email" sourceRef="Task_SendEmail" targetRef="Participant_Engineer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OEE" name="OEE" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OEE" name="Start OEE monitoring">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Loop_Merge" name="Measurement cycle">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoBelow_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Restarted_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_DataGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_DataOrDisconnect" name="Data or disconnection?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_DataGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DataGateway_DataReceived</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DataGateway_Disconnected_Idle</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Evt_DataReceived" name="Machine data received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DataGateway_DataReceived</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DataReceived_Calculate</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DataReceived" messageRef="Msg_MachineData"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Evt_Disconnected_Idle" name="Machine disconnected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DataGateway_Disconnected_Idle</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disconnected_Idle_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Disconnected_Idle" messageRef="Msg_MachineDisconnected"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CalculateOEE" name="Calculate OEE">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DataReceived_Calculate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Calculate_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OEE_Check" name="OEE below threshold?" default="Flow_NotBelow_Merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Calculate_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Below_StopMachine</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotBelow_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_StopMachine" name="Stop machine" messageRef="Msg_StopCommand">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Below_StopMachine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StopMachine_Email</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendEmail" name="Send email to engineer" messageRef="Msg_EngineerEmail">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StopMachine_Email</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Email_RestartGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_RestartOrDisconnect" name="Restarted or disconnected?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Email_RestartGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RestartGateway_Restarted</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RestartGateway_Disconnected_Stop</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Evt_Restarted" name="Machine restarted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RestartGateway_Restarted</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Restarted_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Restarted" messageRef="Msg_MachineRestarted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Evt_Disconnected_Stop" name="Machine disconnected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RestartGateway_Disconnected_Stop</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disconnected_Stop_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Disconnected_Stop" messageRef="Msg_MachineDisconnected"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ProcessStopped" name="OEE process stopped">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disconnected_Idle_End</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disconnected_Stop_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Merge" sourceRef="Start_OEE" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_DataGateway" sourceRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_DataOrDisconnect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DataGateway_DataReceived" sourceRef="Gateway_DataOrDisconnect" targetRef="Evt_DataReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DataGateway_Disconnected_Idle" sourceRef="Gateway_DataOrDisconnect" targetRef="Evt_Disconnected_Idle"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DataReceived_Calculate" sourceRef="Evt_DataReceived" targetRef="Task_CalculateOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Calculate_Check" sourceRef="Task_CalculateOEE" targetRef="Gateway_OEE_Check"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below_StopMachine" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OEE_Check" targetRef="Task_StopMachine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">oeeValue < oeeThreshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotBelow_Merge" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OEE_Check" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoBelow_Merge" sourceRef="Gateway_OEE_Check" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StopMachine_Email" sourceRef="Task_StopMachine" targetRef="Task_SendEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_RestartGateway" sourceRef="Task_SendEmail" targetRef="Gateway_RestartOrDisconnect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RestartGateway_Restarted" sourceRef="Gateway_RestartOrDisconnect" targetRef="Evt_Restarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RestartGateway_Disconnected_Stop" sourceRef="Gateway_RestartOrDisconnect" targetRef="Evt_Disconnected_Stop"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restarted_Merge" sourceRef="Evt_Restarted" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disconnected_Idle_End" sourceRef="Evt_Disconnected_Idle" targetRef="End_ProcessStopped"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disconnected_Stop_End" sourceRef="Evt_Disconnected_Stop" targetRef="End_ProcessStopped"/>

  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Merge" sourceRef="Start_Measure" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge"/>

    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Machine" name="Machine"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Engineer" name="Engineer"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_MachineData" name="Machine data" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="Task_CollectData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_StopCommand" name="Stop command" sourceRef="Task_StopMachine" targetRef="Participant_Machine"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_EngineerEmail" name="Email" sourceRef="Task_SendEmail" targetRef="Participant_Engineer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Restarted" name="Machine restarted" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="Evt_Restarted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Disconnected" name="Machine disconnected" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="Start_Disconnected"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OEE" name="OEE" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OEE" name="Start OEE monitoring">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Loop_Merge" name="Measurement cycle">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotBelow_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Restarted_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_Collect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectData" name="Collect machine data">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_Collect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_Calculate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CalculateOEE" name="Calculate OEE">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Collect_Calculate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Calculate_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OEE_Check" name="OEE below threshold?" default="Flow_NotBelow_Merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Calculate_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Below_Stop</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotBelow_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_StopMachine" name="Stop machine" messageRef="Msg_StopCommand">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Below_Stop</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stop_Email</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendEmail" name="Send email to engineer" messageRef="Msg_EngineerEmail">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stop_Email</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Email_Restarted</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Evt_Restarted" name="Machine restarted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Email_Restarted</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Restarted_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Restarted" messageRef="Msg_MachineRestarted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Disconnected" name="Machine disconnected" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Disconnected" name="Machine disconnected" isInterrupting="true">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disconnected_End</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Disconnected" messageRef="Msg_MachineDisconnected"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ProcessStopped" name="OEE process stopped">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disconnected_End</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disconnected_End" sourceRef="Start_Disconnected" targetRef="End_ProcessStopped"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Merge" sourceRef="Start_OEE" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Collect" sourceRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge" targetRef="Task_CollectData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Calculate" sourceRef="Task_CollectData" targetRef="Task_CalculateOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Calculate_Check" sourceRef="Task_CalculateOEE" targetRef="Gateway_OEE_Check"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below_Stop" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OEE_Check" targetRef="Task_StopMachine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">oeeValue < oeeThreshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotBelow_Merge" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OEE_Check" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stop_Email" sourceRef="Task_StopMachine" targetRef="Task_SendEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_Restarted" sourceRef="Task_SendEmail" targetRef="Evt_Restarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restarted_Merge" sourceRef="Evt_Restarted" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge"/>

  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
